stories.title: Disposable income in Flintshire rose 7 per cent in 2024, ONS figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire has the third highest disposable household income per head in Wales, according to figures published by the Office for National Statistics. The county recorded £23,426 per head in 2024, behind only Monmouthshire at £28,010 and the Vale of Glamorgan at £26,733. stories.title: Airbus engineers lift more than 365 tonnes in Wales Air Ambulance challenge

stories.title: Chester Zoo: ‘World-first’ cancer treatment saves python after tumour destroys part of her jaw
stories.summary: A 15-foot python at Chester Zoo has been declared free of cancer after vets adapted a treatment used on human patients for use in a snake.
